Alex (Sales): Maria from Acme — quick recap: they want SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning + customer-managed KMS for token encryption during POC. They also asked about RBAC mapping and whether Dedicated gives better isolation. Can we clarify options and cost delta?
Priya (Solutions): Thanks — short answers: 1) KMS: we support customer-managed KMS for Private & Dedicated; hosted supports envelope encryption via our KMS only (enterprise request required). 2) SAML: we accept IdP metadata upload; attribute mapping supports nameid/email and custom claims. 3) SCIM: supports delta and bulk; rate limits configurable on Dedicated. 4) RBAC: we can map IdP groups -> roles; can show mapping file.
Maria (Acme IT): Is there an example mapping for groups->roles? Also need confirmation that keys stay in our VPC/HSM during POC — legal will need the statement.
Priya (Solutions): Example mapping:
```
scimGroups:
  - name: eng
    role: inference.admin
  - name: ops
    role: inference.viewer
```
We can produce a formal MOA for KMS locality. For POC we can run Dedicated in a customer VPC with keys in your KMS/HSM.
Sam (Security): Two asks from security: 1) pen-test acceptance criteria (we require a 14-day notice + scope), 2) crypto algorithms — we support AES-256-GCM + RSA-2048 for key wrapping; HSMs must be FIPS 140-2/3 compliant. Also need SCIM audit logs retention: default 90 days on hosted, configurable on Dedicated/Private.
Jordan (Legal): Also need to confirm breach notification SLA and a statement about no key export by Redwood staff. I'll draft a one-page addendum; what's the earliest POC start?
Alex (Sales): Acme wants to start week of 4/18, 6 week POC. Budget asks — they asked for a hosted-monthly quote vs 3mo Dedicated — Maria can you confirm expected qps/seat count?
Maria (Acme IT): We expect ~2k QPS at peak for embeddings + 150 active users for chat. Prefer Dedicated if perf/cost wins but need price compare.
Priya (Solutions): For 2k QPS embeddings you'll want Dedicated with batching + KV cache enabled; I'll run rough cost sim and post numbers. Quick question: Do you need SCIM group sync frequency < 1 min? That affects rate limits and cost.
Maria (Acme IT): 1 minute sync would be ideal for role churn during onboarding.
Sam (Security): Note: <1 min SCIM sync is allowed on Dedicated but we'll recommend gating for delta size. Also ensure SAML session timeout aligns with your SSO policy — we can set session duration up to 12 hours.
deploy-bot: Support ticket INC-2026-451 created for KMS addendum and pen-test preflight. Assignee: Jordan (Legal), Priya (Solutions).
Alex (Sales): Great — Priya/Jordan: can you aim to have the KMS addendum + pen-test guide by EOD Friday? I'll give Maria a timeline.
Priya (Solutions): On it — will post a draft config + cost sim by Thu.
Jordan (Legal): I'll start the addendum draft and link it here when ready.
Maria (Acme IT): Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call tomorrow to align.
Alex (Sales): Scheduling now, sending calendar invite. :calendar:
